questions.q: Choose the correct form: “She suggested ____ the meeting.”
questions.why: 'Suggest' takes a gerund, not an infinitive. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Complete the sentence: “Nowhere in the report ____ any mention of side effects.”
questions.why: Negative adverbial in front: verb 'be' precedes 'there'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In the sentence “The day when we met was memorable,” the clause “when we met” is a:
questions.why: 'When' here is a relative adverb qualifying the noun 'day'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the error: “The man, whom everyone thought was honest, cheated them.”
questions.why: 'Who' is the subject of 'was honest'; 'everyone thought' is parenthetical. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “He ____ have stolen the money; he was out of town that day.”
questions.why: 'Cannot have' + past participle expresses certainty that something did not happen. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “equivocal”:
questions.why: 'Equivocal' means open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: She is a twenty-five year-old surgeon.
She is a twenty five year old surgeon.
She is a twenty five-year old surgeon.
questions.why: A compound modifier before a noun is hyphenated throughout. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “The poet and philosopher ____ dead.”
questions.why: One article for both nouns means one person, so the verb is singular. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct article: “____ Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world.”
questions.why: Names of single mountains take no article. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the one word for: “A person who bears pain and hardship without showing feelings”
questions.why: A stoic endures suffering with calm self-control. GPSC-style practice item.
